options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Logic Difficulty
options.doc:
Decides how difficult the logic is:
Easy: Every Boss requires a strong Animatronic, Late Game checks are only in logic with certain characters (Garuntees good characters early on)
Normal (recommended): Late Game requires certain characters and/or attacks (Higher chance of good characters earlier)
Hard: Only certain Bosses require characters with Neon Wall or Gift Boxes
Insane: Everything is expected to be done without any strong characters, including every Bosses
options.doc_fr:
Décide combien la logique est difficile:
Easy: Chaque Boss a besoin d'un puissant contrôle Animatronic, Late Game sont seulement en logique avec certains caractères (Garuntees bons caractères tôt)
Normal (recommended): Le jeu tardif nécessite certains caractères et/ou attaques (plus de chances de bons caractères plus tôt)
Hard: Seulement certains Boss ont besoin de personnages avec le mur du néon ou des boîtes cadeaux Insane: Tout est attendu pour être fait sans caractères forts, y compris tous les Boss

options.name: Cheaper Shop Prices
options.doc: Halves the price of every Item in every Shop

options.name: Require Find Char
options.doc:
Makes every character location logically require the Find Characters chip
This means you can still find characters, but they are not logically intended to be found yet.

options.name: Progressive Animatronics
options.doc: Makes you get animatronics in a randomized set order, but with stronger animatronics later in the order

options.name: Progressive Bytes
options.doc: Makes you get bytes in a randomized set order, but with stronger bytes later in the order

options.name: Progressive Chips
options.doc: Makes you get chips in a randomized set order, but with stronger chips later in the order (Some chips may be excluded)

options.name: Progressive Areas
options.doc:
Makes you get areas in randomized set order, but with more progression into one direction of the map.
e.g.:
Choppy's Woods -> Dusting Fields 
Lilygear Lake -> Blacktomb Yard -> Pinwheel Circus
Halloween Land -> Geist Lair

options.name: Warp Access
options.doc:
How do the warp buttons function?
visit_area: You have to trigger the warp the same way as vanilla.
always: You only need the Access Switch/Access item for that area to warp there.
warp_item: Similar to always, but you need an additional item for warping.

options.name: Halloween Minigame Lock
options.doc:

true: Randomizes the Accesses for the Minigames into the pool, you'll need an Item for each Minigame
false: Minigames are Accessible as soon as you can enter Halloween Land
